name: ice-motion-director
description: Motion design and video editing director for coding agents. Writes code (HTML, CSS, GSAP, Remotion, FFmpeg) and renders deterministic films: launch films, app ads, explainers, kinetic type, social shorts, YouTube and podcast edits, reference remakes, Lottie and UI motion, Arabic and RTL included.

interface.longDescription: Ice Motion Director turns a coding agent into a motion design and editing studio. It routes each request to one workflow (films from scratch, voiceover-led explainers, remakes in the style of a reference, edits of your own footage, Lottie and UI motion, or ideas and scripts), asks only the questions that change the film, researches and decides every creative choice with a logged reason, writes the film as code, renders it deterministically and checks it with measured quality gates before delivery. Arabic and right-to-left text are supported throughout.
defaultPrompt: Make a 20-second launch film for my product
Cut this podcast recording into three vertical shorts with captions
Make a new film in the style of this reference video
